message:
fix(apk): the decoder's queue is a reservation, the inbox cap holds for every frame, a failed codec is retried (bounded) and re-arms the owed IDR (keepalive-r2 e, Codex apk-decoder-liveness src r1 N1 N2 N3 D1)

N1 (Codex reproduced: candidate 101's input dequeue held, RX brought 202, both went into the codec, bound 202).
The worker calls the codec with mu_ released, so a gate check before dequeue/queue said nothing about the
moment the bytes go in, and the RECEIVE side moved the local selection's candidate (Admit). Now
(selection_ack_gate.hpp): Admit lets an IDR through and changes nothing; the worker RESERVES the gate for the
frame it queues (ReserveQueue: the unbound local selection's candidate is the worker's choice), and the frame
counts only if that reservation is still current after the queue (CommitQueue: pays the owed IDR / binds). Every
control-side change (Prepare / Reset / BeginLocal / Refuse / OnAck) bumps the gate's epoch and asks for a codec
reset. Per exchange: a change seen after the dequeue -> the frame is not queued, the codec voided; a change
while the queue runs -> the bytes went into a voided codec, pay / bind / bootstrap nothing, no picture of it
counts. First IDR into the codec binds; another generation is refused at its own queue. The first output marks a
selection ready only once its generation is decided (expected != 0). No codec call under mu_.

N2: the 4 MB inbox cap had no bound for the last frame. Now a frame over the cap is refused at the door (lost
like a dropped one: owed again, key asked, gap) and the total holds always. 4 MB > one whole second at
kRuntimeBitrateMax (30 Mbit/s = 3.75 MB); the assembler admits up to 16 MB. Outside the inbox the worker holds at
most 4 more frames within the same cap: 20 MB in all.

N3: a codec create that failed while the host went idle (its IDRs spent on the failures, the 8 owed asks used up)
never came back. Now the worker retries the create itself, every 1 s, at most 20 times per surface / selection /
binding; a codec made so re-arms the owed IDR (a new token: the same bounded asks). Past the retries the state is
failed_terminal (logged once): a new surface, a new selection or an IDR from the host brings it back. No new
request budget, no transport change.

D1: a non-null Surface whose ANativeWindow cannot be had is refused (0) -- it was a detach before.

Tests (stand-in NDK: input dequeue / queue can now be held, a window acquire can fail):
- android_decoder_liveness_test 63/63 (x3), new [9] Codex's schedule, [9b] the mirror, [10] [11] a new pick in
  the dequeue / the queue, [12] the cap, [13] the acquire failure; the 7a79b09 sink + gate: 10 FAIL ([9] A1 B2
  bound 202, [10], [12], [13]).
- android_decoder_idr_recovery_test 49/49, new U5 (create fails, idle: recovers +96 ms) and U5b (terminal, then a
  new surface); 7a79b09: 3 FAIL (U5 never recovers).
- decoder_pending_slot_test 21/21 (gate reservation cases), prelogin_select 60, owed_key 32, binding 17,
  decode_stats 42, geometry 10, session_liveness 9. NDK buildCMakeDebug (4 ABIs) OK; no APK built.
